Live Inc Launches EvaSportsPredict an AI Powered Sports Prediction Platform Powered
by Eva’s AI, the new platform turns live sports data into clear predictions, probabilities and betting insights while opening a
broader pipeline of consumer AI products LOS
ANGELES, Oct. 27, 2026 - Eva Live Inc. (NASDAQ: GOAI) (“Eva Live” or the “Company”), an artificial intelligence
and technology company today announced the launch of EvaSportsPredict , an AI-powered sports prediction platform built to help
fans make smarter, more informed decisions before the game begins. Powered
by Eva’s AI technology, EvaSportsPredict evaluates team performance, scoring trends, player and personnel data, venue conditions,
sportsbook odds and other relevant signals. The platform converts that information into clear game predictions, projected scores, over-under
probabilities, confidence levels and potential value opportunities. “Sports
fans have access to more information than ever, but more data does not automatically lead to better decisions,” Eva Live said.
“EvaSportsPredict turns that noise into a clear signal. Eva evaluates the matchup, explains what the model sees and gives every
user a more intelligent way to approach the game.” One
intelligent platform across multiple sports EvaSportsPredict
supports professional and college baseball, football, hockey and basketball. Each sport uses a dedicated model designed around the factors
that influence that game rather than one generic formula applied across every league. Members
can explore daily matchups, review the platform’s strongest selections, track their own picks, evaluate historical performance
and compare their results with Eva. The platform also records timestamped forecasts and final outcomes so its models can be measured,
recalibrated and improved as more completed-game data becomes available. “We
are not building another page full of picks,” Eva Live, Inc CEO David Boulette said. “We are building an accountable sports
intelligence platform that measures itself, learns from its results and becomes more useful as its dataset grows.” A
large and highly engaged opportunity Sports
fans increasingly follow games with a second screen open, looking for fast, understandable analysis before and during a matchup. EvaSportsPredict
is built for that moment. It brings modeling, market context, personal tracking, competition and rewards into a single experience designed
for participation rather than passive consumption. By
making advanced sports analysis easier to understand, Eva Live sees an opportunity to serve both experienced bettors and everyday fans
who want a more informed view of the games they already follow. A
recurring revenue model designed to scale EvaSportsPredict
uses a direct-to-consumer subscription model. New members can try the platform free for 14 days, after which a standard membership is
$19.99 per month. The free trial lowers the barrier to adoption, while paid memberships create recurring revenue as the subscriber base
grows. Features
such as personalized pick tracking, value alerts, performance history, challenges, rewards and leaderboards are designed to give members
reasons to return throughout each sports season. Eva Live expects that ongoing engagement to support subscriber retention and create
a more durable relationship than a one-time transaction. As
Eva Live introduces additional Eva-powered products, the company will also have opportunities to cross-promote services, introduce bundled
memberships and expand the value of each customer relationship. Those future offerings could extend the recurring-revenue model beyond
sports while allowing the company to build on one shared AI platform. The
first of many Eva powered products EvaSportsPredict
is the first public product in a broader rollout built around applying Eva’s AI to real-world decisions and everyday experiences.
Eva Live plans to introduce additional Eva-powered products over the next several weeks, each focused on turning complex information
into practical intelligence people can use. “EvaSportsPredict
is the opening kickoff,” Eva Live said. “Sports is an ideal place to demonstrate what Eva can do because the results are
public, measurable and impossible to hide. Every prediction creates accountability, every outcome creates an opportunity to learn, and
this is only the beginning.” EvaSportsPredict
is available now at evasportspredict.com . About
Eva Live Inc Eva
Live Inc is building a new generation of AI-powered products designed to transform complex data into useful, accessible and engaging
experiences. Powered by Eva’s AI, the company is developing products across sports and other high-interest consumer categories,
with additional launches planned over the coming weeks. Cautionary
